_: Typical numbers the dashboard sets a game's own beside, each with where it comes from. A game's genre (config/games.json) picks its row; games is the fallback. Rates are shares (0.334 is 33.4%). Update a number only with its source.

page_to_download.label: Product page to download
page_to_download.what: Downloads for every product page view

impression_to_download.label: Impression to download
impression_to_download.what: Downloads for every time the listing is shown in search or browse

impression_to_page.label: Clicks to the listing
impression_to_page.what: Product page views for every time the listing is shown
impression_to_page.derived: No published benchmark for unpaid listings. This is AppTweak's impression-to-download rate divided by its page-to-download rate.
impression_to_page.source: Derived from AppTweak, US App Store, 2025

retention.what: New players who play again that many days later. Low is the bottom quarter of games, typical the median, high the top quarter.

first_month.label: Downloads in the first month
first_month.what: The share of new apps that have passed a download count by a given week
